name: Spirit Pendulum
description: A brass plumb on a fine chain; it leans toward what the spirit world notices.

name: Divination Kit
description: Cards, chalk, and a steady hand for reading the city's drift.

name: Spirit Lens
description: A smoked glass that shows what lingers where a thing once happened.

name: Dream Draught
description: A bitter tincture that lets sleep do the connecting.

name: Gray-Fog Focus
description: A focus that briefly steadies a corner of the Gray Fog for reading.

name: Consecrated Chalk
description: For drawing a ritual circle that holds its shape against the Gray Fog.

name: Tallow Candle
description: Cheap, smoky, and necessary for the smallest divinations.

name: Dream Herb
description: Dried gray leaves that thin the wall between waking and sleep.

name: Dream Residue
description: A faint condensate left after a dream-reading; still potent.

name: Ritual Salt
description: Coarse gray salt the cell hoards for the warehouse circle.

name: Service Revolver
description: A worn service revolver; it answers to a steady hand and whatever rounds are left in the pocket.

name: Revolver Round
description: A heavy lead round. The city sells fewer of these than it should.

name: Hunter Characteristic
description: The crystallised essence that precipitates from a slain Hunter-pathway Beyonder. Digest it via the acting ritual to climb the Sequence — knowledge bought at the price of your mind.

name: Hermit Characteristic
description: The crystallised essence that precipitates from a slain Hermit-pathway Beyonder — starlight caught in salt. Digest it via the acting rite to climb the Sequence: knowledge bought at the price of your mind.

name: Death Characteristic
description: The crystallised essence that precipitates from a slain Death-pathway Beyonder — grave-cold caught in bone-ash. Digest it via the corpse-collector's office to climb the Sequence: knowledge bought at the price of your mind.

name: Shilling
description: A worn silver shilling. The city runs on these; so does Franky's counter.

name: Tainted Characteristic
description: An off-pathway essence — useless to your own digestion, but ritual fuel or quiet income sold to a church fence.
